mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post (owner_id, title, slug, status) VALUES (#{ownerId}, #{title}, #{slug}, #{status})
INSERT INTO post_draft (post_id, content_json, schema_version, version, updated_by) VALUES (#{postId}, #{contentJson}, #{schemaVersion}, #{version}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT id, owner_id, title, description, slug, status, published_revision_id, created_at, updated_at, published_at FROM post WHERE id = #{postId} AND owner_id = #{ownerId} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, owner_id, title, description, slug, status, published_revision_id, created_at, updated_at, published_at FROM post WHERE slug = #{slug} AND status = 'PUBLISHED' LIMIT 1
SELECT id, post_id, revision_no, content_json, schema_version, created_by, created_at FROM post_revision WHERE id = #{revisionId} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, status FROM post WHERE id = #{postId} AND status = 'PUBLISHED' LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_comment (post_id, author_id, content) VALUES (#{postId}, #{authorId}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.post_id, c.author_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(u.nickname), ''), u.username) AS author_name, u.avatar_asset_id AS author_avatar_asset_id, c.content, c.created_at FROM post_comment c INNER JOIN post p ON p.id = c.post_id AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED' INNER JOIN user_account u ON u.id = c.author_id AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE c.id = #{commentId} LIMIT 1

SELECT c.id, c.post_id, c.author_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(u.nickname), ''), u.username) AS author_name, u.avatar_asset_id AS author_avatar_asset_id, c.content, c.created_at FROM post_comment c INNER JOIN post p ON p.id = c.post_id AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED' INNER JOIN user_account u ON u.id = c.author_id AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE p.slug = #{slug} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT id, post_id, content_json, schema_version, version, updated_by, created_at, updated_at FROM post_draft WHERE post_id = #{postId} LIMIT 1
SELECT revision_no FROM post_revision WHERE post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY revision_no DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_revision (post_id, revision_no, content_json, schema_version, created_by) VALUES (#{postId}, #{revisionNo}, #{contentJson}, #{schemaVersion}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET status = 'PUBLISHED', published_revision_id = #{revisionId}, published_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{postId} AND owner_id = #{ownerId}
